name: Joovy Caboose (original / Caboose Graphite)

clekListed.clekRow: Joovy Caboose — Universal Car Seat Adapter

specs._unfoldedNote: Assembled (in-use) size 41.5 H x 21.5 W x 38 D in per the original Joovy Caboose Stand-On Tandem retail listing (Amazon B001AXJ8O0) — mapped to length(depth) 38, width 21.5, height 41.5. Consistent with the current Caboose family (~38 L x 21.5 W x 42 H).

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: front seat from ~3 mo or newborn with an infant car seat via adapter; rear standing platform ~2.5 yr+

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833 (mandatory for US strollers); Clek confirms all listed strollers were tested to the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness front seat; 3-way reclining front seat. Joovy does not publish a per-model JPMA certification.

specs.strollerType: sit-and-stand tandem double (front seat + rear bench/standing platform; optional rear seat sold separately)
